Inicia sesión, pulsa el botón + «Publica: Sign in, press + to post and select "I found it". Enter the name and description, category and date, where you found it and a clear image. Confirm the map location, then press "Post Item".
Sign in, press + to post and select "I lost it". Enter the item name and details, category, date and last place you saw it. You can add an optional reward and publish the report.
Coordina la entrega o el retiro en un lu: Arrange handover in a busy public place in Alta Gracia, such as a square, police station or town centre, preferably during the day. Do not share your home address.
Abre tu perfil y busca la publicación. A: Find the post in your profile and open Manage recovery. A linked counterpart must confirm the handover; without one, explicitly confirm your own declaration. The conversation is kept. Deleting a post also deletes its associated conversations.
Abre el detalle del objeto y pulsa «Cont: Open the item details and press "Contact the publisher" to send a message. Private phone and town information is shared only after both people exchange messages about the same item.
En Inicio puedes buscar por nombre, desc: On Home, search by name, description or place. You can also filter by lost or found items and category. "Near me" requires browser location permission.
BuscAG compara automáticamente los repor: BuscAG automatically compares lost and found reports in the same category. Check Matches or the item details and contact the publisher if you recognise the item.
Puedes crear una cuenta desde la pantall: Create an account on the sign-in screen. If you receive a confirmation email, open it before signing in. You can reset your password or resend confirmation from that screen. New passwords need at least 8 characters.
La búsqueda cercana necesita permiso de: Nearby search needs browser location permission. If you prefer not to share it, text search and filters work without location.
